channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: STF extrapola ao incluir Zema em inquérito das fake news, diz Caiado
item.description: Former Goiás governor and presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) defended Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) after the STF included Zema in a fake news investigation. Caiado called the measure an overreach by the Supreme Federal Court and emphasized that Zema is a potential rival in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Lula fará 2 procedimentos médicos no hospital Sírio-Libanês, em SP
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) will be admitted to the Sírio-Libanês Hospital in São Paulo on Thursday, the 23rd, to undergo two simple medical procedures. The Presidency’s Secretariat of Communication confirmed the exams will take place between Friday, the 24th, and Saturday, the 25th. There is no indication of seriousness regarding the procedures.

item.title: Deputado explica por que Flávio Bolsonaro deve ‘surpreender’ nas próximas pesquisas
item.description: Deputy Filipe Barros (PL) states that Flávio Bolsonaro’s strategy of presenting himself as more moderate in the 2026 election is natural and reflects his existing political profile, not an artificial construct. He emphasizes Lula’s growing rejection, the ease of uniting the right and center-right, and the inevitability of a judicial reform debate as key factors that could lead Flávio to 'surprise' in the polls, despite internal divisions within the conservative camp.

item.title: Lula passará por dois procedimentos cirúrgicos nesta sexta
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will undergo two medical procedures this Friday, the 25th, at the Sírio-Libanês Hospital in São Paulo: removal of a scalp keratose and an injection in the right wrist to treat thumb tendinitis. The Presidency's Secretariat of Communication confirmed the schedule, which does not indicate seriousness. The procedures are routine and aimed at health maintenance.

item.title: Lula passa por dois procedimentos médicos no Sírio-Libanês nesta sexta-feira
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will undergo two medical procedures at the Sírio-Libanês Hospital on Friday, May 24: removal of a keratosis on his head and an injection in his right wrist to treat tendinitis. The Presidency stated the interventions are simple, require no rest, and will not result in physical restrictions. Lula is expected to return to Brasília on Sunday to attend a Workers' Party congress.

item.title: Governo envia ao Congresso plano para baixar gasolina com arrecadação do petróleo
item.description: The Lula government has submitted a bill to Congress allowing tax reductions on fuels such as gasoline and ethanol when there is an extraordinary increase in oil revenue. The measure aims to cushion the domestic impact of rising international oil prices due to the Middle East conflict by converting part of the fiscal gain into direct consumer relief, initially focusing on gasoline, which still carries R$ 0,47 per liter in federal taxes.

item.title: Lula vai a SP para passar por procedimentos na cabeça e no punho
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will undergo medical procedures in São Paulo on Friday to remove a skin growth (keratosis) on his head and receive an injection to treat tendonitis in his right thumb. The government says the procedures are minor and will not require rest, allowing Lula to fulfill official commitments in São Paulo’s interior and attend the PT’s National Congress in Brasília over the weekend.

item.title: PT, PV e PCdoB pedem suspensão de perfil feito por IA com críticas a Lula
item.description: The PT, PV, and PCdoB parties filed a representation with the TSE to suspend the 'Dona Maria' social media profiles, which use an AI-generated character to criticize President Lula. They argue the accounts spread disinformation and misuse AI to damage his image.

item.title: Van Hattem acusa Gilmar de “xenofobia” e “homofobia” contra Zema
item.description: Federal deputy Marcel van Hattem (Novo-RS) accused Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes of xenophobia toward people from Minas Gerais and homophobia toward former Minas governor Romeu Zema (Novo), stating Mendes 'is not well'. The allegations came amid Mendes' public criticisms of politicians from the Novo party.

item.title: Lula faz procedimentos na pele e no punho nesta sexta (24) em São Paulo
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, 80, will undergo two medical procedures this Friday (24) in São Paulo: skin cauterization and a wrist injection to relieve pain in his right thumb. The procedures are routine and aimed at addressing age-related discomfort and repetitive strain.

item.title: Governo negocia solução para dívidas do agro sem pré-sal e com prazo de seis anos
item.description: The Lula government is negotiating a solution for agribusiness debt without using the R$30 billion from the pre-salt Social Fund, as requested by the sector. Finance Minister Dario Durigan proposed an alternative based on securitization with a six-year repayment term. The plan aims to meet agribusiness demands while preserving strategic public resources.

item.title: TSE decide que proibição a voto de presos provisórios não valerá em 2026
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) ruled that new rules restricting the vote of pretrial and temporary detainees will not apply in the 2026 elections. As a result, voter registration and the installation of voting sections in prison units remain valid for this year's election. The decision ensures these individuals can continue to exercise their right to vote.

item.title: Governo Lula propõe usar receita extra com petróleo para cortar impostos sobre combustíveis
item.description: The Lula government proposed to Congress using extraordinary oil revenues to cut taxes on fuels, such as PIS/Cofins and CIDE, to mitigate the impact of the Iran war on domestic prices. Announced by Finance Minister Dario Durigan, the measure involves a cost of R$30.5 billion, but the government claims no fiscal impact due to the use of excess revenues. The bill was filed by the government leader in the Chamber, Deputy Paulo Pimenta (PT-RS).

item.title: Lula vai a São Paulo para fazer cauterização na cabeça e infiltração por causa de tendinite na mão
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva travels to São Paulo for two medical procedures: cauterization to remove a scalp keratosis and an injection in his right wrist to treat thumb tendonitis. Both are scheduled for Friday at the Sírio-Libanês Hospital, with no prior preparation or contraindications. Afterward, he will rest at his Pinheiros residence through Saturday; his attendance at the PT Congress closing in Brasília on Sunday remains unconfirmed, and on Monday he will undertake interior São Paulo engagements, including inaugurations in Presidente Prudente and Andradina.

item.title: PT, PV e PC do B acionam TSE contra o perfil “Dona Maria”
item.description: The PT, PV, and PC do B parties filed a complaint with the TSE seeking the suspension of social media profiles identified as 'Dona Maria', which use AI-generated imagery of an elderly woman to spread political disinformation targeting Lula, the left, and the STF, while promoting Bolsonaro-aligned narratives. They argue the profiles fail to consistently disclose their AI nature, misleading users into believing the character is real, and may be monetized through advertising partnerships, violating electoral laws on anonymous political propaganda.

item.title: Lula fará retirada de acúmulo de pele na cabeça e infiltração no punho para tratar tendinite, diz Planalto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will undergo medical procedures in São Paulo on Friday (24) to remove a skin accumulation (keratosis) on his head and receive an injection in his right wrist to treat tendinitis. The government states the procedures are simple and require no rest, with his official engagements postponed to Monday (27). Lula is expected to return to Brasília on Sunday (26) to attend a Workers' Party congress.

item.title: Romeu Zema cresce no conflito com Gilmar Mendes e aumenta desgaste do STF
item.description: The conflict between Minister Gilmar Mendes and former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) is increasing wear on the Supreme Court while boosting Zema's political visibility, according to columnist Fernando Schüler, who cites the Barbra Streisand effect. The tension raises concerns about censorship of political humor and satire in Brazil, warning that treating criticism as an attack on the rule of law could lead to an Orwellian regime. Zema is gaining prominence in the 2026 electoral race, with increased engagement and attention due to the judicial dispute.

item.title: Eleitor em Dia: prazo para tirar o título antes do fechamento do cadastro se encerra em 6 de maio
item.description: The deadline to obtain a voter ID, transfer electoral domicile, update registration data, or regularize electoral pendings ends on May 6, 2025. After this date, the electoral registry will be closed for the 2026 Elections. Services are available online via the TSE Portal or in person at electoral offices, with biometric procedures requiring in-person attendance.

item.title: O novo capítulo da troca de farpas entre Gilmar Mendes e Romeu Zema
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes mocked the accent of former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema, likening it to a Timorese dialect in a Record TV interview. Zema responded on social media, accusing Mendes of losing moral clarity and using authoritarianism to suppress criticism. The conflict arose after Mendes requested Zema be investigated in the fake news inquiry over an animation depicting him as corrupt.

item.title: TSE aprova transferência de R$ 13 milhões para Itamaraty organizar eleições no exterior
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unanimously approved the transfer of R$ 13.2 million to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Itamaraty) to rent properties abroad for the 2026 presidential elections, aiming to accommodate 65 electoral sections in countries where Brazilian embassies or consulates lack capacity. The funding supports voting access for approximately 793,330 Brazilians registered overseas, a figure that has steadily increased since 2010. The TSE must designate the sections by July 6, and Itamaraty must request additional sections by June 22.

item.title: Lideranças femininas acompanham sessão do TSE desta quinta (23)
item.description: Over 70 female leaders attended the TSE session to monitor rulings and advocate for the 30% gender quota in candidacies. They stressed that combating feminicide and domestic violence must be permanent political priorities, not just election-season topics. Stafanie Lucena and Yannahe Marques shared personal testimonies to underscore that women's political participation is vital for repairing social harm and saving lives.

item.title: Projeto aperfeiçoa decisão de investimento na previdência complementar
item.description: PLP 87/2026, proposed by Senator Esperidião Amin (PP-SC), seeks to require an absolute majority in the deliberative council of closed pension entities to approve investments of 5% or more of guarantor resources, banning the chair’s tie-breaking vote. The initiative aims to strengthen governance and mitigate financial risks while preserving the LC 108/2001 framework.

item.title: Governo volta atrás e diz que não vai reduzir imposto da gasolina
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan stated that the Lula government will not announce a reduction in federal taxes on gasoline, despite earlier communications indicating such an announcement was planned to counter international fuel price increases. He clarified that the press conference was intended to discuss a mechanism under consideration in Congress to enable future tax reductions, not to implement an immediate cut, and that no formal announcement had ever been made. Planning Minister Bruno Moretti criticized media coverage for framing the situation as a 'retreat', noting that a complementary bill had been submitted to Congress to establish a neutral fiscal regime for fuel tax reductions.

item.title: “Imagina que comecemos a fazer bonecos do Zema como homossexual”, diz Gilmar
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes criticized satirical cartoons by former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema depicting him and Justice Dias Toffoli, stating that creating similar caricatures of Zema as homosexual would be equally offensive.

item.title: TSE e Google reforçam ação digital para regularização do título de eleitor a 13 dias do prazo final
item.description: The TSE and Google have strengthened a digital initiative to facilitate voter registration, featuring a direct link on Google Brazil's homepage to the Electoral Self-Service platform. The deadline for registration, address transfer, and data updates is May 6, after which the electoral roll will close for the 2026 elections. The effort aims to expand online access to Electoral Justice services.

item.title: Crusoé: Moraes dá prazo para Eduardo apresentar alegações finais em processo
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes set a 15-day deadline for the Attorney General's Office and Eduardo Bolsonaro to present final arguments in a criminal case investigating alleged coercion. The ruling was issued on Thursday, the 23rd, and also includes a five-day period for the Tribunal to review any requests.

item.title: Senador que será candidato a governador vai coordenar campanha de Flavio Bolsonaro em Rondônia
item.description: Senator Marcos Rogério, the PL’s pre-candidate for governor of Rondônia, will coordinate Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign in the state, just as Tarcísio de Freitas will do in São Paulo. The exclusive article highlights the political coordination among Bolsonaro allies ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Governo propõe reduzir impostos sobre combustíveis usando receita extra com petróleo
item.description: The Lula government proposed to Congress a bill to reduce PIS/Cofins taxes on fuels such as gasoline and ethanol when extraordinary oil revenue exceeds initial estimates, using the surplus as compensation. The measure aims to counter the impact of rising global oil prices due to the Middle East war and would apply only during the conflict. Until May, the focus would be on gasoline, as diesel and biodiesel already have no federal taxation.

item.title: Lula diz que chamou delegados que estariam ‘fingindo trabalhar’ para cobrar combater crime
item.description: President Lula said he asked the Justice Minister to summon Federal Police delegates who are outside the force and agents allegedly 'pretending to work' to strengthen the fight against organized crime. He stated this would be the first time all PF positions are filled by career servants, following a decree to recruit 1,000 new agents. Lula also criticized Donald Trump, saying he will bring jabuticaba to 'calm him' during future trips abroad.

item.title: Presos provisórios poderão votar em 2026, decide TSE
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unanimously ruled to maintain voter registration and polling station setup in prisons for the 2026 elections, allowing pretrial detainees to vote. The decision upholds voting rights despite proposed changes in the Electoral Framework bill.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes morde isca e impulsiona estratégia eleitoral de Zema ao rebater críticas contra o STF
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes' reaction to Governor Romeu Zema's criticisms of the STF inadvertently boosted Zema's 2026 electoral strategy by reinforcing his image as a political outsider targeted by the system. Mendes' critique of Zema's informal speech style triggered identification among voters who feel alienated by formal linguistic norms, mirroring effects seen with Lula and Bolsonaro. This strengthens Zema's narrative as a 'common citizen' opposing the elite, despite his low current polling (around 3%).

item.title: Partidos de esquerda pedem a suspensão de ‘Dona Maria’, perfil de IA que viraliza com críticas ao governo
item.description: Left-wing parties from the Brazil of Hope Federation (PT-PCdoB-PV) have requested the Electoral Court to suspend the AI-generated profile 'Dona Maria', arguing that the content fails to clearly disclose its artificial nature, spreads disinformation, and exhibits clear political bias by criticizing the Lula government while praising Bolsonaro. The profile, created by app driver Daniel Cristiano dos Santos using Google’s Gemini, went viral with over 12 videos surpassing 1 million views each between July 2025 and April 2026.

item.title: Valdemar se reúne com Zanin após Alerj pedir ao STF que Douglas Ruas assuma interinamente governo do Rio
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, met with STF Minister Cristiano Zanin after the Alerj requested that Douglas Ruas assume the interim governorship of Rio, while Zanin had already suspended the indirect election for the post, keeping Judge Ricardo Couto as interim governor until the legal determination on Cláudio Castro’s resignation, which may be deemed an electoral crime leading to his disqualification until 2030.

item.title: Diplomacia/ Refúgio de golpistas
item.description: The United States expelled Brazilian Federal Police delegate Marcelo Ivo de Carvalho over allegations of manipulating immigration procedures in the arrest of Alexandre Ramagem, who was convicted for attempting a coup. The Trump administration claimed the official bypassed formal extradition requests, but Brazil maintained the arrest was based on international police cooperation. In retaliation, Brazil’s PF director-general revoked the diplomatic credentials of a U.S. immigration agent operating in Brazil. Meanwhile, Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes requested the inclusion of Romeu Zema in the fake news investigation after Zema posted a puppet video implying favoritism toward Justice Dias Toffoli, which boosted Zema’s social media following and reactivated Bolsonarist mobilization against the STF.

item.title: Batata quente
item.description: The Banco Master scandal, tied to banker Daniel Vorcaro, resurfaced following the preventive detention of the ex-president of BRB, revealing suspicious ties between Minister Alexandre de Moraes and Vorcaro, including messages attesting to his seriousness. Although Moraes has not judged any Master-related inquiries, the case raises concerns in the STF, government, and Congress, with potential political implications and possible accusations, despite PGR Paulo Gonet having archived investigation requests against the minister. Bolsonarism is lobbying the Trump government to apply the Magnitsky Act against Moraes.

item.title: A polêmica das blusinhas
item.description: The government is considering repealing the 'blusinhas tax' (20% import tax on purchases under $50) as part of a broader package to improve electoral prospects, including debt renegotiation, ending the 6×1 work schedule, and zero-fare public transit. The proposal faces strong opposition from Finance Minister Dario Durigan and over 50 business groups, despite support from ministers like José Guimarães and Guilherme Boulos. Economists warn that the restrictive fiscal framework limits more universalist policies, even as popular measures are under review.

item.title: Do poço ao posto
item.description: The article argues that the privatization of BR Distribuidora and the dismantling of Petrobras have left Brazil vulnerable to international oil price fluctuations, turning consumers into hostages of the market. Although emergency measures by the Lula government have prevented larger fuel price increases, the lack of public control over distribution reveals a structural flaw in national energy security. The PT's bill (PL 1853) aims to restore a public fuel distribution company to reclaim state control 'from well to pump'.

item.title: ‘A rua convoca, a urna confirma’: Parada LGBT+ de SP terá tema político em ano eleitoral
item.description: The São Paulo LGBT+ Pride Parade, marking its 30th anniversary, has adopted the political theme 'The street calls, the ballot confirms' for the 2026 elections, linking street resistance to voting as an act of survival. The movement opposes Bolsonarism and religious intolerance, with expectations of strong support for Lula’s re-election, including figures like Congresswoman Erika Hilton. The event will take place on Paulista Avenue, though the number of sound trucks and musical acts remain unannounced.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Caiado poupam munição contra ministros, e Zema se firma como candidato anti-STF
item.description: Governor Romeu Zema (Novo) intensified his criticism of the STF through satire and social media, positioning himself as an anti-system candidate, which prompted Minister Gilmar Mendes to request his inclusion in the Fake News inquiry. While Flávio Bolsonaro and Ronaldo Caiado refrain from attacking the Court, Zema devoted 81.3% of his recent tweets to the STF, generating solidarity among allies and tension with opponents who expected stronger aggression from Bolsonaro.

item.title: Moraes abre prazo para alegações finais e ação contra Eduardo Bolsonaro entra na reta final
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes has set a 15-day deadline for final arguments in the criminal case against Eduardo Bolsonaro, who is accused of process obstruction by attempting to influence his father Jair Bolsonaro’s trial through U.S. government pressure for sanctions against Brazil. This stage represents the parties’ last opportunity to present conclusions before the First Panel of the STF rules on guilt or innocence. Eduardo failed to attend a prior hearing and did not submit a preliminary defense, prompting the Public Defender’s Office to represent him.

item.title: Ex-relator da CPMI do INSS faz exame de DNA após acusação de estupro
item.description: Federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (União-AL) underwent a DNA test at Alagoas' official forensics office after being accused of rape by Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) and Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MS), who allege he raped a 13-year-old girl eight years ago, resulting in a pregnancy registered under the maternal grandmother's name. Gaspar denies the claims, attributing them to confusion with a cousin, and has filed for the removal of the accusers' mandates while petitioning the Supreme Federal Court. He shared a video of the DNA collection on social media, asserting his innocence and demanding swift justice.

item.title: Governo Lula decide reduzir tributos sobre gasolina para combater efeitos da guerra no Iră
item.description: The Lula government announced a reduction in PIS/Cofins taxes on gasoline to counteract the impact of the Iran war on fuel prices. The measure is part of a broader package to control inflation, though specific details of the tax cut have not yet been disclosed.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula convoca delegados da PF que estão “fingindo trabalhar”
item.description: President Lula (PT) stated that he ordered Justice and Public Security Minister Wellington César Lima to summon all Federal Police delegates who are "pretending to work," citing alleged absences or low productivity. He said he had previously requested the minister issue a note calling these servants back to duty.

item.title: Zema diz que Brasil deveria ter lei para banir o 13º andar
item.description: Romeu Zema, a pré-candidate for president from the Novo party, suggested Brazil should pass a law to ban the 13th floor in buildings, claiming the number 13 is associated with the Workers' Party (PT) and considered bad luck. In a video posted on X, he advocated skipping from the 12th to the 14th floor, as done in some countries, and asked social media users what they thought.

item.title: Governo barra Terrabras e abre racha com PT no Congresso
item.description: The Lula government decided to block the creation of the state-owned Terrabras in the critical minerals framework, causing a rift with PT congressmen who advocate for greater state participation in the mineral sector. The decision, made in a meeting at the Palácio da Alvorada, prioritizes establishing a critical minerals council linked to the presidency as an alternative to a public company. Congressional allies admit the proposals are unlikely to advance in 2026, with possible revival only in a potential fourth term of Lula.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula entrega prêmio de incentivo à leitura
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) attends the World Book Day ceremony in Brasília, where he presents the 9th Vivaleitura Award and signs, alongside the Ministers of Education and Culture, the ordinance establishing the National Book and Reading Plan 2026-2035. The event aims to highlight outstanding reading promotion projects and set guidelines for public policy in the area over the next decade.

item.title: Lei Antifacção não vai barrar votos de presos provisórios em 2026, decide TSE
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) ruled that the Anti-Facão Law, which bans voting by provisional and temporary prisoners, does not apply to the 2026 elections due to the principle of electoral annuality. The court stated that legislative changes cannot be implemented this year due to technical time constraints and lack of integration between electoral and security systems, so prisoner voter registration and voting in prisons will remain in place for this year's election.

item.title: Lula usa novo atrito com EUA para retomar discurso de soberania, faz gesto à PF e endossa retórica de 'guerra contra o crime'
item.description: Lula used the diplomatic friction with the U.S. over the withdrawal of an FBI agent at Trump’s request to revive his national sovereignty narrative and announce the hiring of 1,000 approved candidates for the Federal Police, framing it as part of a 'war on organized crime'. He praised PF Director-General Andrei Rodrigues and stressed the need for more federal police to arrest criminals, amid the presidential race against Flavio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Governo Lula torrou ao menos R$ 860 milhões com a COP30
item.description: The Lula government's Civil House reported that direct spending on organizing COP30 amounted to at least 860 million Brazilian reais, including contracts, agreements, and projects managed by the event's Extraordinary Secretariat. The figure was disclosed in response to a Chamber of Deputies request and covers 16 detailed expense categories.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes ironiza sotaque de Zema ao comentar inquérito das fake news
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes mocked the accent of former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema, saying he speaks a 'dialect close to Portuguese' and compared his speech to Tetum, the language of Timor-Leste, during remarks on Zema's inclusion in the fake news inquiry over puppet shows and deepfake videos satirizing justices. Zema responded by expressing pride in his roots, accusing the Court of corruption, and stating the ridicule offends millions of Mineiros, reinforcing his campaign narrative against the 'untouchables' of the judiciary.
